statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail holds the base of the watch band because the Globex restart is trading two-way, while Stress stays elevated on a 2007-high 10-year yield and a 71% probability of an October rate hike.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold. The published danger window is the 24 September U.S. cash open from 13:30 to 15:00 UTC, where opening-auction continuation against an aligned rates, oil and semiconductor backdrop is the structure that would deny retracement.
headline: Nasdaq-100 futures hold a 35-point Globex band after a 2007-high 10-year yield drove an orderly 0.85% Nasdaq-100 decline
body: The live Globex path remains the decisive evidence and it is not continuative. Nasdaq-100 futures trade 30,791.25, up 26.50 points or 0.09% on the session, and every print since the 22:00 UTC restart fits a 35-point 30,778.00 to 30,813.00 band. The market has drifted about 19 points lower within that band over the past hour without attempting an extension, which is two-way rotation rather than the persistent directional efficiency that defines Tail. That follows a risk-off but orderly 23 September cash session. The Nasdaq-100 closed 30,470.29, down 262.10 points or 0.85%, inside a 30,353.88 to 30,706.23 range and roughly 116 points above its low, so the index did not settle on the lows. The Nasdaq Composite fell 1.13%, the S&P 500 0.75%, the Dow 0.68% and the Russell 2000 1.77%, so breadth was the weakest part of the tape. Rates drove it. The 10-year Treasury yield rose about 15 basis points to 5.11% after an intraday peak near 5.135%, its highest since 2007, while the 30-year reached 5.37% and the 2-year jumped more than 13 basis points to about 4.9%. The Federal Reserve H.15 release confirms the prior 22 September base at 4.71% for the 2-year, 4.96% for the 10-year and 5.29% for the 30-year. S&P Global's flash composite PMI printed 58.4 against a 55.3 consensus, with services at 58.7 and manufacturing at 57.0, and input costs at their steepest since October 2022. Fed Governor Michael Barr said further policy adjustments are likely to be needed, and traders moved to roughly a 71% probability of a hike at the 27-28 October FOMC meeting. WTI crude settled near 92.12 dollars, up 1.81%, with Brent close to 100 dollars. The amplifier stack is therefore real but incomplete. Shared Finviz context collected at 23:14 UTC, 12 minutes before this assessment, reports its futures and calendar sections unavailable, so it contributes no live price-path evidence; its latest-session, non-real-time breadth shows semiconductors negative in all seven covered names for a mean of -1.36%, and megacaps averaging -1.13% but split with three of eight higher, including Meta up 1.02% and Microsoft up 0.52%. Software-Infrastructure closed 0.79% higher against Communication Services down 1.82%. That internal split, a VIX of only 15.18 despite a 6.83% rise, and a cash close well off the lows are the reasons Tail sits at 20 rather than in the elevated band: the environment is difficult, which Stress captures at 51, but no pathological no-retracement path has been observed. Two catalysts sit inside the forecast window without providing observed structure. Mark Zuckerberg's Meta Connect keynote began at 23:00 UTC in the current clock hour, covering AI glasses and an upgraded personal AI agent, and the main Trump-Xi bilateral is scheduled at the White House on 24 September with trade, artificial intelligence, critical minerals, Taiwan and Iran on the agenda. No verified time has been published for that bilateral, so it is carried as a driver-level checkpoint rather than as a calendar event.

lookbackSummary: The prior 24 hours divide sharply at the 23 September U.S. data window. Through the overnight and European morning, Claude published Tail between 10 and 15 with Stress in the mid-30s while the Nasdaq-100 held a quiet uptrend and then a neutral range. The 14:00 UTC hour marked the regime change: the flash PMI beat, its steepest input-price reading since October 2022 and the accompanying yield surge pushed Tail to 25 and Stress to 54 in a trend-down assessment. Tail then decayed steadily to 21-24 with Stress between 53 and 57 across the remainder of the cash session, and to 20 with Stress 52 through the maintenance halt, because the decline stayed orderly and retracements remained available rather than becoming one-way extension.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours are shaped by an unresolved rates backdrop rather than by an observed one-way equity path. The current hour has a live, narrow and two-way Globex price path. Conditional risk steps up marginally into the 00:00 UTC Tokyo cash open, the first checkpoint for whether a 2007-high U.S. 10-year is imported into Asian equities and long-end JGBs, then decays to a modelled overnight floor of Tail 19 across the thin 03:00-05:00 UTC stretch. Risk rebuilds at the 07:00 UTC European cash and bond opens, the second transmission checkpoint, and then into the 24 September U.S. sequence: jobless claims at 12:30 UTC are modelled as whipsaw rather than sustained Tail, and the conditional peak of 24 sits across the 13:30 UTC cash open and the 14:00 UTC New Home Sales print. The published danger window closes at 15:00 UTC, by which point the opening auction has either produced a failed-retracement sequence or it has not. Risk then decays through the U.S. afternoon, with a small premium restored for the final cash hour, and reaches its lowest modelled readings after the 20:00 UTC close.
